page.overview:
Who is Harper?

is a major character in 1:35 A.M., the first story in the book of the same name. She's Delilah's upbeat and spiritual best friend who tries her best to support Delilah following her divorce.

Harper is thin with huge blue eyes and blonde hair she likes to tie up in different styles. When Delilah first talks to Harper about Ella, she has an “exotic Medusa look” with her hair in a dozen or so braids coiled around her head, heavy colorful makeup, and a skintight green dress. Later, her hair is in a long, high ponytail and she wears a fifties-style, full-skirted floral dress with a multitude of bracelets around her thin wrists.

Harper is vivacious and likes to act mischievous, calling herself a free-spirit. She is also very eccentric and spiritual, believing in signs and other ideas that Delilah considers unrealistic. Harper isn’t as easily bothered as her best friend, but also doesn’t process things in an organized way either. Despite their opposing views, Harper and Delilah are very supportive of each other, and Harper is always willing to help Delilah out whenever she needs it.

Harper and Delilah landed in foster care together six years prior to the events of the story. Despite being opposites in both looks and personality, the two teamed up to help each other get through their scheduled life with Gerald, the ex-military husband of the couple that took them in, and were determined to make the foster home their last. They managed to make their friendship work and remained friends after.
